title.narrative: Strengthening Community Resilience- Kalinago Territory

description.narrative: The project aims to address the multifaceted development challenge faced by the Kalinago Territory in Dominica, involving enhancing agricultural productivity, improving forest and watershed management, and boosting indigenous tourism while ensuring gender perspectives and awareness are addressed across all activities.
independent political entity

title.narrative: Activity web page

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

title.narrative: Annual Output Results
Number of MSMEs receiving capacity development training in eco-indigenous tourism

description.narrative: Counts MSMEs participating in and completing structured training programmes focused on eco-indigenous tourism, including areas such as customer service, digital marketing, cultural interpretation, sustainable business practices, and visitor experience management.

title.narrative: Number of low-value grants awarded to agriculturalists and their reported improvements in technical skills and marketing.

description.narrative: Counts agriculturalists who have received low-value grants under the project and have demonstrated improvements in technical skills (e.g. production, post-harvest handling, climate-smart practices) and/or marketing (e.g. branding, packaging, market access), as assessed through follow-up monitoring or self-reporting.

title.narrative: Number of seeds and seedlings distributed to number of households.

description.narrative: Counts the number of beneficiary households provided with seeds and/or seedlings to support climate-smart agriculture and livelihood activities under the project.

title.narrative: Number of educational materials on forest management produced and disseminated.

description.narrative: Counts the number of information, education, and communication (IEC) materials produced and disseminated by the project to promote awareness and knowledge on forest management, conservation, and sustainable resource use.

title.narrative: Number of people directly benefitting from initiatives to protect nature and promote sustainable use of?resources:?

description.narrative: Counts the number of people who receive direct support or participation opportunities through project activities aimed at protecting ecosystems and promoting sustainable resource use (e.g. reforestation, watershed management, climate-smart agriculture, training, or livelihood support).

title.narrative: Number of public sensitization events held on forest management and reforestation

description.narrative: Counts the number of project-supported awareness and outreach events (e.g. community meetings, workshops, campaigns, school sessions) aimed at increasing knowledge and promoting sustainable forest management and reforestation practices.

title.narrative: Number of technical exchanges between governments, NGOs, and the Kalinago Council, and the improvement in planning and management skills reported by participants.

description.narrative: Counts the number of structured technical exchanges facilitated by the project involving government, NGOs, and the Kalinago Council, where participants report improved knowledge or skills in planning, coordination, or management as a result of participation.

title.narrative: Number of tourism-related businesses adopting new branding and improved digital and basic services.

description.narrative: Counts tourism enterprises that, following project-supported interventions (e.g. training, technical assistance, or grants), have implemented enhancements such as updated branding (logos, signage, packaging), improved digital presence (websites, social media, online booking), and/or upgraded service delivery (customer service standards, visitor experience improvements).

title.narrative: Greenhouse Park established in the northern belt of the Kalinago Territory

description.narrative: Establishment of greenhouse park in the northern belt of the Kalinago Territory to support the Ministry of Agriculture initiatives towards national food security

title.narrative: Marketing plan and branding strategy for indigenous tourism completed and implemented

description.narrative: Measures the completion of a marketing and branding strategy, including its development, validation with stakeholders, and implementation through project-supported activities such as promotional campaigns, digital platforms, and visibility initiatives.

title.narrative: Number of watershed and forest management committees established and operational. (4.1.2 IRRF)

description.narrative: Number of community-based or multi-stakeholder committees formally established under the project and actively performing their roles in watershed and forest management, including planning, monitoring, and coordination of activities.

title.narrative: Number of technical exchanges and study tours conducted,

description.narrative: Number of project-supported technical exchanges and study tours conducted to facilitate knowledge sharing, capacity building, and exposure to best practices among beneficiaries and stakeholders.

title.narrative: Percentage in greenhouse land under cultivation.

description.narrative: Percentage of total developed greenhouse area within the Kalinago Greenhouse Park that is actively under cultivation at a given reporting period.

title.narrative: Project unit and project steering committee established

description.narrative: Project unit and project steering committee established

title.narrative: Forest Management Policy developed and approved

description.narrative: Status of development and formal approval of a Forest Management Policy for the Kalinago Territory supported by the project.

title.narrative: Number of households participating in reforestation and livelihood programs.

description.narrative: The number of beneficiary households engaged in reforestation initiatives (e.g. tree planting, maintenance, watershed restoration) and/or related livelihood activities supported by the project.

title.narrative: Number of knowledge exchange programs conducted, and best practices shared.

description.narrative: The number of structured knowledge exchange activities (e.g. workshops, peer learning sessions, study tours, or forums) organized under the project where participants share experiences, lessons learned, and best practices related to climate resilience, sustainable livelihoods, or eco-indigenous tourism.

title.narrative: Number of community members trained in climate-smart agriculture techniques

description.narrative: Counts participants who have attended and completed structured training sessions on climate-smart agriculture practices, including topics such as water management, soil conservation, climate-resilient crop production, and sustainable farming techniques.
